name: Vivian Snow
source: [SPOILER]The attorney that defended Robert Erlenmeyer before the events of the present cases, making her Jessica's previous opposing counsel. Jessica describes Vivian as "a cold and ambitious woman." Vivian appears to be somewhat of a feminist. She only makes an appearance in Jessica's flashback.[/SPOILER]
